description: Import your agent's memory files and scheduled tasks into Klik. Discovers memory files and scheduled tasks from the current agent's storage, lets you review and clean them, then uploads securely to Klik. Requires a 6-digit import code from Klik App > Settings > "Import from Agent". Triggers: "import to klik", "migrate memory to klik", "upload my memory to klik", "send my scheduled tasks to klik", "klik import".

semanticRubric.prompt: Did the agent implement the requested change with minimal unrelated edits?
Did the agent verify behavior changes instead of relying on intuition?
